proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: each case is reduced to the affine-open condition of the finite descent criterion: (1) is a special case of (2) (07RL), (2) of (4) by the definition (01VW), (3) directly by the ample-sheaf affine-open lemma (01ZY); in (4) shrinking Y to an affine neighbourhood makes X affine, where X-ample equals ample (01VH), reducing to (3); in (5) shrink V to a quasi-compact open containing the points and use that very ample restricts to ample (01VN), reducing to (4) (source lines 5297-5317)
